steps.content: The Sinner walks up to the villa's Security Chief, who stumbles backward in fright. She salutes him in standard FAC style, then stands there silently, as if awaiting instructions.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: What... kind of strange power did you use just now?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: When did an anti-Mania force like FAC recruit Sinners?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The situation is dire. The enemy is using high-level Mania power on a massive scale. FAC must reassemble the special dispatch team to deal with the emergency.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: What about restraining measures? Don't tell me that mask on your face can keep you from losing control.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ha, of course it can't.
Did she sneer behind her mask just now? The Security Chief can't tell for sure, but he instinctively takes a step back.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: When the MBCC gets back on their feet, perhaps someone will come to restrain me. But as of now, they can't even restrain their own Sinners.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You don't have much time. You wouldn't want the guest from Paradeisos to die in your jurisdiction, right Security Chief?
She glances at the villa behind her, where panicked footsteps can be heard from time to time. It seems the attack had wreaked total havoc inside.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Tsk... I protect everyone in the jurisdiction. You're a Sinner. I cannot guarantee that you're safe to deploy.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't worry, Mr. Security Chief. I'm an FAC soldier first, a Sinner second.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: My power poses no threat to you. You're facing ferocious enemies, and I can be of use.
She shows him her high-level FAC credentials, which does certify her skills and safety.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Then how can you be of use?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Tonight's attack is but the beginning. There aren't just Sinners among the enemies, but also many Mania-infected creatures. They stem from evil forces you cannot deal with.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Better evacuate the protection target back to Paradeisos. I'll escort you.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: That won't work. She refused, and we can't convince her. The higher-ups haven't responded, either.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Then let me go inside the villa. I'll give her the best protection.
The Security Chief's face twitches.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: ...And who will vouch for you?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You. The next attack is coming soon. Your existing defenses will be pummeled in one blow.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: You're pushing it too far! The lady's from Paradeisos. How can we let a Sinner go near her? Their attitude towards Mania is crystal clear!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: The problem this time is that reinforcements didn't arrive in time. The fault is on your side. You stand on guard outside and make sure no one approaches before the protection target is relocated. That's your only job right now!

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: Also, I don't care if you're from the FAC or anywhere else. Unless the higher-ups say otherwise, I'm the Security Chief around here, and you have to obey my orders. You got it? You...

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: <size=44>Are you laughing at me??</size>

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ha, don't worry, you're not that funny. I will obey the orders.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: By the way...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Does the code <color=#fb9259>05257885</color> ring a bell?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: What?
Rahu carefully observes his expression. It's one of genuine confusion, so she picks up her shields and turns to leave, but not before having a last word.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I suggest you stop calling for more reinforcements. No one aside from me is going to come. Besides...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: If the enemy and Mania were to hide among reinforcements, you wouldn't be able to tell with your level of expertise.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: If that happens, you'd be guilty of personally bringing the enemy to our distinguished Paradeisos guest.

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'll be standing guard and waiting for orders at the nearest sentry post.
Rahu ends the conversation there, and quickly returns to the nearest sentry post. The night has gotten calmer as the contamination and danger fade away.
Another encrypted comms message comes in from the FAC team, but this one deliberately by-passed review controls. Rahu answers the comms. A familiar and anxious voice rings out from the other end.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: Rahu? Where are you?! Why did you act on your own accord again?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The FAC received an urgent call for help. Erica Villa was under attack. There were A-Class Sinners among the attackers. Eastside sheriffs can't deal with them alone.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm the best candidate to deal with something like that, right Captain?

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: Who are you trying to fool?! When have you ever asked for permission? You've stirred up enough trouble as it is. If any more violations come to light, even I can't help you smooth things over. You'll be labeled a high-risk Sinner and get arrested!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Then let them arrest me. I won't stop.
The person on the other end shouts angrily. Rahu didn't respond. After a while, the caller finally calms down.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: ...I just submitted a mission application on your behalf. If the higher-ups ask, I'm only smoothing things over for you for one week. But there's going to be the <color=#fb9259>Blue Rain Project</color> in two days, so be careful out there. Don't cause any trouble.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: I know what you're doing, Rahu. But we won't get what we want by pursuing Paradeisos like this.

steps.speaker: FAC Encrypted Call
steps.content: Don't end up sacrificing yourself.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Thank you for your support, Commander. I will get the job done.
She hangs up the comms and looks toward the villa where the Paradeisos guest is staying. A floral scent wafts over. Rahu frowns and makes herself remember this maddening scent.
The first night is over, and her first step can only go so far.
But tomorrow, she will get more closer.
